source.note_posted_date_basis: note title suffix 261122 interpreted as 2026-11-22 Asia/Shanghai; unverified against platform timestamp
source.source_url_basis: derived from note_id; xsec_token omitted from public export
source.post_likes_basis: value shown on the user profile note card at collection time

capture_method.readback: User profile loaded in a logged-in browser; card metadata extracted from DOM (section.note-item); cover image URL downloaded with Referer header via curl after urllib was reset by local proxy.
capture_method.ocr_preprocessing: cover upscaled 3x with ffmpeg lanczos (640x296 -> 1920x888), then cropped into overlapping left/right and per-row slices at 2x-3x for glyph disambiguation
capture_method.ocr_uncertainty_note: Book/author names transcribed from a low-resolution embedded table. Several glyphs remain ambiguous and are flagged medium/low with per-item ocr_notes; no glyph was resolved by guessing.

parsing.ranking_scope: single screenshot of one daily ranking table; not the full platform ranking
parsing.column_semantics_note: likes/danping/comment_status are cover-image labels; '喜欢' and '弹评' are numeric counts as printed, '评论现状' is a qualitative tag.
parsing.tags_normalization: original comma/、 separators rendered as '/' in CSV for readability

analysis_boundary: Single-cover OCR of a third-party public ranking screenshot. Book/author names and counts are best-effort transcription from an embedded low-resolution table, not verified against the original platform; several glyphs flagged medium remain ambiguous. Qualitative comment_status is the screenshot author's label, not measured data. Do not treat as official ranking or as read book text. No full text of any work is stored.
